about.title: About the Vivid Voltage set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Vivid Voltage is a Sword & Shield expansion released on 13 November 2020. It has 203 cards: 185 in the main set and 18 secret rares. There are also 142 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 185 main set cards), the Master set (327 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 345 cards, adding the 18 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
